name: Steel Rattan 4 Seater Outdoor Sofa Set
material: steel frame w/t powder coated.w/t PE rattan and cushions
description: The well-woven rattan of this patio conversation set not only adds a piece of elegance but also withstands long-time outdoor use. The heavy-duty steel frame ensures strong weight capacity and high stability. Both the loveseat and single sofas are comfortable to sit with curved armrests and high backrests. The coffee table with a wide glass tabletop makes every daily item you need easily accessible. Whether you want to relax in the backyard, poolside, balcony, or garden, this patio rattan set will always be an awesome choice.
